answer: The design leans on reputation staking with slashing conditions. Each submission hangs on the jetty of a task receipt, and the canyon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. By the gale of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a historical context, lessons from prior systems register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
